tree.heading: Administrator
tree.text: The term “Administrator” means the Administrator of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.

tree.heading: Appropriate committees of Congress
tree.text: The term “appropriate committees of Congress” means—

children.text: the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation of the Senate; and
the Committee on Science 1 of the House of Representatives.

tree.heading: Cis-lunar space
tree.text: The term “cis-lunar space” means the region of space from the Earth out to and including the region around the surface of the Moon.

tree.heading: Deep space
tree.text: The term “deep space” means the region of space beyond cis-lunar space.

tree.heading: ISS
tree.text: The term “ISS” means the International Space Station.

tree.heading: NASA
tree.text: The term “NASA” means the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.

tree.heading: Near-Earth space
tree.text: The term “near-Earth space” means the region of space that includes low-Earth orbit and extends out to and includes geo-synchronous orbit.

tree.heading: NOAA
tree.text: The term “NOAA” means the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.

tree.heading: OSTP
tree.text: The term “OSTP” means the Office of Science and Technology Policy.

tree.heading: Space Launch System
tree.text: The term “Space Launch System” means the follow-on government-owned civil launch system developed, managed, and operated by NASA to serve as a key component to expand human presence beyond low-Earth orbit.
